questions.prompt: Explain how the map of cases provides evidence for the source of the outbreak.
questions.modelAnswer: The cases are not spread evenly across the town; most are clustered around well B, and when counted, far more households are nearest to well B than to any other well. Since cholera spreads through contaminated water, a cluster around one water source suggests that well is contaminated. The few distant cases can be explained if those people used well B. Testing the water in well B would confirm it.
rubric: Uses counts or comparison with other wells
